fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, IT Ops (links to VS-27), Field IT, Finance (links to VS-35), Security (links to VS-27.3)

workflows.name: IT Asset Discovery, Inventory & CMDB Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "IT Asset Mgr/IT Ops" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-reconcile of "Reconcile CMDB to procurement" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Audit physical existence at sample locations" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-526 (ensure controlled execution — IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Deployment (PA-99.1).); CTL-143 (ensure IT asset & license entitlement integrity — cross-reference.)
- operational: network discovery and quarantine; operational: CMDB–fixed-asset reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Shadow-IT risk**: Unmanaged devices bypass security and support; mitigated by network discovery and quarantine
- **Ghost-asset risk**: Paying maintenance/insurance on retired assets still on books; mitigated by CMDB–fixed-asset reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Discovery/CMDB (links to VS-27); fixed assets (links to VS-35); security (links to VS-27.3)

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr/IT Ops (links to VS-27.2) maintain discovery tools (agent-based and network scan) that automatically detect hardware/software on the network; capture device identity (hostname, serial, MAC), specs, location, user, status; load into CMDB as the single source of truth

Reconcile CMDB to procurement (links to VS-34), fixed-asset register (links to VS-35), and finance; identify discrepancies (ghost assets on books but missing, shadow/rogue devices on network but unbought/unknown); investigate and correct

Audit physical existence at sample locations (stores/DCs/HQ) vs CMDB (links to VS-35.3 physical verification methodology); address rogue/unmanaged devices (quarantine per VS-27.3); report CMDB accuracy KPI to IT governance
steps.r: IT Asset Mgr / Internal Audit (links to VS-21) / Field IT

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, Procurement (links to VS-34), IT Ops (links to VS-27), Finance, Vendor
fields.Trigger: New-store opening (links to VS-37); refresh (W3238); ad-hoc demand

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "scanner, mobile, laptop, network, server, printer" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "catalog compliance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "record in CMDB" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-526 (ensure controlled execution — IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Deployment (PA-99.1).)
- operational: catalog enforcement and approval gates; operational: framework agreements and safety stock
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-standard-buy risk**: Off-catalog devices inflate support cost and break standardization; mitigated by catalog enforcement and approval gates
- **Lead-time risk**: Import lead time for hardware delays store openings (VS-37); mitigated by framework agreements and safety stock
System Touchpoints: - Procurement/PO (links to VS-34); CMDB (W3233); fixed assets (links to VS-35); receiving
Time Estimate: - Per procurement cycle; ongoing catalog maintenance

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr/IT Ops maintain the standard hardware catalog: approved makes/models per device class (POS terminal, scanner, mobile, laptop, network, server, printer), standard configurations, lifecycle/roadmap, total-cost-of- ownership basis; standardization reduces support complexity and spare-pool breadth

Procurement/IT (links to VS-34) source via framework agreements / preferred vendors: negotiate price, warranty, lead time, RMA process, trade-in; consolidate demand for new-store openings (VS-37) and refresh waves (W3238); enforce catalog compliance (reject non-standard buys)
Receive, asset-tag, and register: assign unique asset tag/serial, record in CMDB (W3233) and fixed-asset master (links to VS-35), capture warranty and PO reference; stage for provisioning (W3235)

fields.Participants: IT Ops Mgr (links to VS-27), Field IT, Store Ops (links to VS-07), IT Asset Mgr

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "IT Ops provision and image devices centrally" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scan of "scanner, printer, network" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document site configuration" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-526 (ensure controlled execution — IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Deployment (PA-99.1).)
- operational: standardized imaging and automation; operational: VS-37 site-readiness checklist
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misconfiguration risk**: Inconsistent images cause support incidents; mitigated by standardized imaging and automation
- **Site-readiness risk**: Store not ready (network/power) delays deployment; mitigated by VS-37 site-readiness checklist
System Touchpoints: - Imaging/MDM (links to VS-27); monitoring (links to VS-27.2); store opening (links to VS-37); CMDB (W3233)
Time Estimate: - 1–4 hours per device; 1–3 days per new-store deployment

steps.activity: IT Ops provision and image devices centrally: standard OS image, security baseline (links to VS-27.3), required applications (POS software, WMS, MDM enrollment, antivirus, monitoring agents), configuration per device role (cashier vs back-office vs DC RF); automate via imaging/zero-touch deployment

Deploy to site: ship to store/DC, Field IT or store staff install and connect (POS, scanner, printer, network), verify connectivity to ERP (links to VS-27.2), test offline POS capability (per POS-013 ≥8 hours offline); capture deployment confirmation in CMDB

Onboard to support: register in monitoring/MDM, assign support owner, document site configuration; for new stores, integrate with VS-37 store-opening commissioning (W227 handover); confirm user acceptance

fields.Participants: IT Ops Mgr (links to VS-27), DC Ops (links to VS-04), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Field IT
fields.Volume: Hundreds of RF guns (DC/stores), mobile devices (managers, field), peripherals

workflows.name: Mobile Device, RF Gun & Peripheral Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "scanners, printers, payment terminals per VS-80" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "catalog" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-526 (ensure controlled execution — IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Deployment (PA-99.1).)
- operational: MDM remote-wipe and accountability; operational: spare pool (W3237) and rapid swap
Pain Points / Risks: - **Device-loss risk**: Mobile/RF devices lost or stolen (links to W3240); mitigated by MDM remote-wipe and accountability
- **Downtime risk**: RF/POS peripheral failure stops operations; mitigated by spare pool (W3237) and rapid swap
System Touchpoints: - MDM (links to VS-27); service desk (links to VS-27.1); payment terminals (links to VS-80); CMDB (W3233)

steps.activity: IT Ops manage mobile/RF estate via Mobile Device Management (MDM): enroll devices, push apps/config (WMS client, task app per VS-63), enforce security (PIN, encryption, remote-wipe per VS-27.3), restrict to business use; geo-locate where enabled

Manage peripherals (scanners, printers, payment terminals per VS-80): firmware updates, consumables (receipt paper, labels), connectivity, compatibility with POS/WMS; maintain peripheral standard catalog (W3234)

Handle damage/loss/replacement: triage via service desk (links to VS-27.1), swap from spare pool (W3237), remote-wipe and deactivate lost devices (W3240), recover/decommission; track device failure rates by model to inform catalog (W3234)

fields.Participants: IT Ops Mgr, Service Desk (links to VS-27.1), Field IT, Vendor/Warranty, Finance
fields.Trigger: Incident (links to VS-27.1); warranty/RMA; preventive maintenance

workflows.name: Asset Maintenance, Break/Fix & Spare Pool Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-escalate of "escalate to Field IT or vendor where needed" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "log warranty status per asset" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile spares inventory" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-526 (ensure controlled execution — IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Deployment (PA-99.1).)
- operational: regional spare pool and swap SLA; operational: warranty tracking and RMA discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Downtime risk**: Critical device failure without spare extends outage; mitigated by regional spare pool and swap SLA
- **Warranty-leakage risk**: Paying for repairs covered by warranty; mitigated by warranty tracking and RMA discipline
System Touchpoints: - Service desk (links to VS-27.1); CMDB/warranty (W3233); spare inventory (links to VS-05/VS-29)

steps.activity: Service Desk (links to VS-27.1) triage break/fix: diagnose (remote first), attempt repair, escalate to Field IT or vendor where needed; for store/DC critical devices (POS, RF), prioritize and swap from spare pool to restore service rapidly

Manage vendor warranty/RMA: log warranty status per asset (W3233), initiate RMA for covered failures, track turnaround, manage out-of-warranty repair/replacement decisions (repair vs replace); manage extended-warranty contracts

Operate spare pool: maintain regional spare-stock levels (POS, RF, laptops) for rapid swap, replenish per min/max, cycle spares to prevent obsolescence, reconcile spares inventory; analytics on failure rates (W3251) feed refresh (W3238) and catalog (W3234)

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, IT Ops (links to VS-27), Finance (links to VS-40/VS-35), Procurement (links to VS-34), Store Ops

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-update of "update CMDB and fixed assets" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "Manage disposal accounting" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-526 (ensure controlled execution — IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Deployment (PA-99.1).)
- operational: lifecycle policy and budget; operational: after-hours/phased rollout
Pain Points / Risks: - **Refresh-deferral risk**: Running unsupported/vulnerable devices (links to W3250); mitigated by lifecycle policy and budget
- **Disruption risk**: Refresh during peak disrupts operations; mitigated by after-hours/phased rollout
System Touchpoints: - Capex/project (links to VS-40); fixed assets (links to VS-35); CMDB (W3233); procurement (links to VS-34)

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr/Finance build refresh plan: device lifecycle policy by class (POS 5–7 yr, laptop 3–4 yr, server 4–5 yr, network 5–7 yr), vendor end-of-support dates (W3250), performance/TCO analysis (W3251), capex budget (links to VS-40); prioritize by risk and ROI

Execute refresh wave: procure (W3234), provision/deploy (W3235) with minimal operational disruption (after-hours, phased by region), recover and retire old devices (W3239), update CMDB and fixed assets (links to VS-35); manage trade-in/resale value

Manage disposal accounting (links to VS-35.3): derecognize retired assets, gain/loss on disposal, transfer to new assets; capture lessons and update refresh policy; report refresh KPI (cycle adherence, residual value)

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, Security (links to VS-27.3/VS-91), Finance (links to VS-35), Sustainability (links to VS-73/VS-25), Disposal Vendor

workflows.name: Asset Retirement, Data Sanitization & E-Waste Disposal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document sanitization certificate per asset" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "record gain/loss/disposal cost, retain sanitization/disposal certificates" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-526 (ensure controlled execution — IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Deployment (PA-99.1).)
- operational: certified sanitization and certificates; operational: accredited TSD vendor and documentation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-breach risk**: Residual data on retired devices (links to VS-91 NPC breach notification); mitigated by certified sanitization and certificates
- **Environmental-compliance risk**: Improper e-waste disposal violates DENR rules (links to VS-73.2); mitigated by accredited TSD vendor and documentation
System Touchpoints: - Security/identity (links to VS-27.3); privacy (links to VS-91); fixed assets (links to VS-35); records (links to VS-88); sustainability (links to VS-73/VS-25)
Time Estimate: - Per asset; 30 min–2 hours including documentation

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr/Security retire devices: revoke access/deactivate (MDM, AD, apps per VS-27.3), perform certified data sanitization (NIST 800-88 / cryptographic erase for SSDs) to ensure no residual BuildRight or customer data (Data Privacy Act RA 10173 compliance, links to VS-91); document sanitization certificate per asset

Decide disposition: redeploy internally (cascade to lower-tier use), resell (trade-in, secondary market — recover value), donate (CSR per VS-25, with sanitization), recycle/dispose as e-waste (DENR-accredited treatment/storage/disposal — TSD facility per VS-73.2 hazardous/e-waste compliance); ensure no data-bearing media leaves unsanitized

Reconcile retirement: derecognize from CMDB (W3233) and fixed assets (links to VS-35.3), record gain/loss/disposal cost, retain sanitization/disposal certificates (links to VS-88) for audit and privacy compliance (links to VS-91); report e-waste and recovery metrics to sustainability (links to VS-25/VS-73)

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), Security (links to VS-27.3), Legal, Insurance (links to VS-26)

workflows.name: Lost / Stolen Asset Recovery & Loss Investigation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "preserve evidence" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews CCTV and access data" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-143 (ensure IT asset & license entitlement integrity.)
- operational: encryption, remote-wipe, and breach playbook; operational: accountability and analytics (W3251)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-compromise risk**: Lost device with customer/employee data triggers RA 10173 breach notification (links to VS-91); mitigated by encryption, remote-wipe, and breach playbook
- **Asset-leakage risk**: Chronic untracked loss; mitigated by accountability and analytics (W3251)
System Touchpoints: - MDM (links to VS-27); loss prevention (links to VS-23); security (links to VS-27.3); privacy (links to VS-91); insurance (links to VS-26)

steps.activity: On loss/theft: immediate containment — remote-wipe/lock via MDM (W3236), deactivate credentials and access (links to VS-27.3), report to local police (for theft) and Loss Prevention (links to VS-23); preserve evidence (last-known-location, access logs, CCTV)

Investigate: Loss Prevention (links to VS-23.1) determines cause/theft/fraud, interviews, reviews CCTV and access data; for high-value or data-bearing devices, assess data-breach risk (links to VS-91) and notify NPC if personal data compromised within 72 hours

Recover/resolve: recover device where possible, file insurance claim (links to VS-26.3) for unrecovered/insured assets, derecognize from CMDB/fixed assets (links to VS-35.3), replace (W3234/W3237); tighten controls (accountability, tracking, physical security per VS-23.2); capture lessons to risk register (links to VS-21.2)
steps.r: IT Asset Mgr / Loss Prevention / Finance
